name: The Bir Spell
hook: Monasteries, tea gardens and a potter's wheel, all inside one long weekend.

quickInfo.duration: 5 days · 2 nights in Bir, 2 on the road
quickInfo.highlight: Pottery in the artist village of Andretta
quickInfo.vibe: Prayer flags, cafe corners & pyjama parties

about.heading: A long weekend, cast properly
about.body:
Board a bus in Delhi on Thursday night and wake up where the Dhauladhar range begins. **Bir does not rush anyone.**

One day belongs to the town: an ice-breaking circle, the quiet of Chokling Monastery and an unhurried cafe trail. One day belongs to your hands: morning light at Wah Tea Estate, an afternoon at the potter's wheel in Andretta and a pyjama party waiting back at the property. Then a slow Sunday: the market, the ancient Baijnath Temple and the night road home.

- Two nights in Bir, two on the overnight bus
- Expected back in Delhi by 6:00 AM on Monday
- The plan flexes with weather, traffic and operational conditions
about.quote: Take Friday off. The mountains handle the rest.

itinerary.title: The Night Bus North
itinerary.subtitle: The city fades behind us
itinerary.description: Meet your circle at the pickup point and claim a window seat. We roll out of Delhi between **8:30 and 9:00 PM** and let the highway do its quiet work: snacks, playlists, first conversations, then sleep as the plains turn into hills.

highlights.text: Pickup from Delhi between 8:30 and 9:00 PM
First hellos on the overnight drive

itinerary.title: Waking Up in Bir
itinerary.subtitle: Strangers become a circle
itinerary.description: Arrive with the morning light and settle in slowly. An **ice-breaking session** turns co-passengers into a circle, Chokling Monastery slows everyone down, and the afternoon disappears into Bir's cafe trail. Dinner is together, back at the property.

itinerary.title: Tea Gardens & the Potter's Wheel
itinerary.subtitle: A day made by hand
itinerary.description: A morning walk through the bushes of **Wah Tea Estate**, then on to Andretta, the little artist village, for your turn at the potter's wheel. Lunch at Her Cafe, and the night belongs to the **pyjama party** at the property.

itinerary.title: Baijnath & the Road Home
itinerary.subtitle: One last slow morning
itinerary.description: The morning is yours: drift through the market and pick up what the mountains should send home with you. We visit the ancient **Baijnath Temple**, then board for the overnight drive back to Delhi.

itinerary.title: Back Before the City Wakes
itinerary.subtitle: The spell holds
itinerary.description: Expected drop in Delhi around **6:00 AM**, early enough for breakfast, a shower and your nine o'clock like nothing happened. Except everything did.

highlights.text: Expected drop in Delhi around 6:00 AM

audience.title: The One-Leave Escapist
audience.description: You get exactly one Friday off. Spend it on monasteries, tea gardens and clay instead of laundry.

audience.title: The Solo First-Timer
audience.description: You arrive alone. The ice-breaking circle makes sure you do not stay that way past breakfast.

audience.title: The Slow-Craft Romantic
audience.description: Potter's wheels, tea bushes and cafe corners: your kind of adrenaline.

tripHighlights.title: A potter's wheel in Andretta
tripHighlights.description: An afternoon of clay in Himachal's little artist village.

tripHighlights.title: Wah Tea Estate
tripHighlights.description: A working tea garden at the foot of the Dhauladhars, walked slowly.

tripHighlights.title: Chokling & the cafe trail
tripHighlights.description: Monastery quiet in the morning, Bir's famous cafes after.

tripHighlights.title: The pyjama party
tripHighlights.description: Saturday night, mountain edition: comfortable clothes, good people, zero agenda.

faqs.question: How much leave do I need?
faqs.answer: One day. Pickup is on Thursday between 8:30 and 9:00 PM, and the expected drop back in Delhi is around 6:00 AM on Monday, before the workday begins.

faqs.question: Where exactly do we board in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Pickup is from Delhi between 8:30 and 9:00 PM on Thursday. The exact boarding point is shared once your seat is confirmed.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary change?
faqs.answer: The itinerary is subject to weather, traffic and operational conditions. Sightseeing may be adjusted to ensure the best travel experience.
